title: When the Locker Wakes
premise: Elodie Amberdale, statistician for the Hollow Creek High varsity team, has spent senior year cataloguing the impossible numbers that prove the school board is rigging games and funneling booster money somewhere dark. When her best friend Priya vanishes, leaving behind a janitor's keyring that opens doors no student should enter, Elodie and the team's benched quarterback Theo follow the keys into the school's sealed sub-basement. There they find records of decades of 'scholarship' players quietly disappeared when they learned too much — including Priya's brother. As the final game approaches, Elodie must choose between publishing the truth and protecting the found family of misfits who've rallied around her, knowing the board will burn everything to keep its secret. In the end, she broadcasts the evidence during the championship broadcast, Priya is found alive in hiding, and the board falls — but Elodie learns that belonging was never something the school could give or take away.
about_author: Mirabel Sterling is a former high school math teacher who spent seven years keeping scorebooks for small-town football teams before turning to fiction. She writes stories about quiet kids who refuse to stay quiet.

chapters.title: The Numbers Don't Lie
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. During a blowout loss she statistically proves the opposing team knew Hollow Creek's plays, but Coach dismisses her spreadsheet and the board rep smiles too easily. Establishes her isolation, her countdown calendar to graduation, and her one friendship with Priya. Emotional beat: resigned cynicism masking a hunger to matter.

chapters.title: Keys
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Priya misses their Friday ritual, then misses school, then stops answering texts. At Priya's locker Elodie finds a dented janitor's keyring with a note: 'If I go quiet, count.' The police call it a runaway case. Emotional beat: dread crystallizing into resolve as Elodie pockets the keys.

chapters.title: The Benched Quarterback
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo, sidelined by a suspicious 'injury' after questioning play calls, recognizes the keyring — he's seen it on Custodian Reyes, who vanished weeks ago. He confronts Elodie in the library; they form an uneasy alliance. Emotional beat: two outsiders discovering they've been watching the same wrongness.

chapters.title: What the Booster Club Buys
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Elodie and Theo dig through years of budget reports at Theo's kitchen table, finding six-figure payments to a company with no address. Theo's mom, a board secretary, nearly catches them. Emotional beat: the thrill of conspiracy giving way to fear of how high it reaches.

chapters.title: Locker 114
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Following Priya's habits, Elodie realizes locker 114 sits directly above the sealed sub-basement stairwell. Inside she finds Priya's hidden notebook: names, dates, and a page torn out. First use of the keys — one fits the stairwell door. Emotional beat: vertigo of realizing Priya was investigating alone.

chapters.title: The Sub-Basement
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. They descend past the boiler room into a corridor of filing cabinets: transcripts, medical waivers, and 'withdrawal forms' for players who officially transferred but have no forwarding schools. A motion sensor light snaps on upstairs. Emotional beat: claustrophobic terror tempered by Elodie's steadying presence.

chapters.title: Withdrawn
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Cross-referencing yearbooks, they confirm three 'transferred' players simply vanished — including Marcus Oyelaran, Priya's brother, class of '19. Elodie's found-family instinct ignites: she starts recruiting the team's overlooked kids. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into purpose.

chapters.title: The Misfit Roster
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV shifts. In the abandoned band room, Elodie assembles her crew: equipment manager Dez, photographer June, statistician understudy Sam. Each has a piece of the puzzle they never thought mattered. Emotional beat: warmth and belonging blooming where there was only loneliness.

chapters.title: Coach Whitlock's Warning
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Coach pulls Theo aside, not to threaten but to beg him to stop — revealing his own son was one of the withdrawn players and he stayed silent to keep his job. Theo leaves disgusted but shaken. Emotional beat: moral complexity; even complicity has wounds.

chapters.title: Tail Lights
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Someone ransacks Elodie's car looking for the notebook; her countdown calendar is stolen. That night a gray sedan follows her home. She calls Theo instead of the police. Emotional beat: paranoia tightening, but choosing each other over authority.

chapters.title: Board Member Bramble
chapters.summary: June's POV. June photographs a clandestine meeting between board chair Bramble and a recruiter from Corvane Athletics Group — the ghost company. The photos show Bramble handing over player files. Emotional beat: vindication and horror; the machine has a face.

chapters.title: The Torn Page
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Reconstructing the notebook's missing page from memory and water damage, Elodie decodes Priya's cipher: a date — the night of the championship game — and the word 'transfer,' meaning Priya planned to be taken deliberately. Emotional beat: fury and awe at Priya's courage.

chapters.title: Sam Gets Caught
chapters.summary: Sam's POV. Sam copies files onto a drive in the computer lab and is cornered by Vice Principal Hargrove, who offers a full scholarship to stay silent. Sam takes the deal — then immediately confesses to the crew. Emotional beat: shame, forgiveness, and the cost of belonging tested.

chapters.title: Split the Drive
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Knowing Hargrove will search, they split the evidence: photos to June's cloud, documents encrypted across four laptops, originals re-hidden in the sub-basement. Trust becomes infrastructure. Emotional beat: the crew hardening from club to family.

chapters.title: Homecoming Ghosts
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV. At homecoming, Marcus Oyelaran's mother approaches Elodie after seeing her ask questions around town. She gives them Marcus's last letter, mailed from a 'relocation facility' in another state. Emotional beat: the stakes turn human and irreversible.

chapters.title: Reyes Returns
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Custodian Reyes resurfaces, half-afraid, and reveals the sub-basement was a Corvane intake site — players scouted, signed, and shipped out under coercive contracts; those who refused were made to disappear. He kept the master key all these years. Emotional beat: an adult finally standing with the kids.

chapters.title: Where Priya Went
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Decoding further, Elodie realizes Priya got herself recruited to reach the facility and find Marcus. A burner phone number in the notebook connects once — a whispered confirmation Priya is alive. Emotional beat: hope arriving like a punch to the chest.

chapters.title: The Last Practice
chapters.summary: Dez's POV. Hargrove suspends Elodie and Theo days before the championship, and the team threatens to forfeit in protest. Coach Whitlock, redeeming himself, leaks the suspension order to the local paper. Emotional beat: solidarity spreading beyond the core five.

chapters.title: Game Day Lockdown
chapters.summary: June's POV. Championship night: packed stadium, state cameras rolling, and Bramble's people sweeping the school. The crew positions themselves — press box, basement hatch, broadcast booth. Emotional beat: coiled anticipation, every thread pulled taut.

chapters.title: Fourth Quarter
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. With two minutes left, Elodie slips into the broadcast booth and cuts the feed to the sub-basement footage and Corvane contracts, narrating the names of the withdrawn players over the PA. The crowd goes silent, then erupts. Emotional beat: triumphant terror — the point of no return.

chapters.title: Aftermath
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. State police raid the school within the hour; Bramble and Hargrove are led out past the bleachers. Corvane's facility is located; Priya and Marcus are recovered alive. The crew finds each other in the emptying parking lot. Emotional beat: catharsis, exhaustion, disbelief turned to joy.

chapters.title: Counting Forward
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Weeks later, Elodie crosses out the last line of her countdown calendar and starts a new notebook — not counting down, but listing what she wants to build. The crew gathers in the band room, now theirs. Emotional beat: belonging chosen freely; the story ends on an open door.
